def test_compiled_site_link_integrity_crawler(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Crawler asserting 100% of internal links resolve to valid destinations (SC-002, T018)."""
    docs_dir = tmp_path / ".buddhi" / "docs"
    docs_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    guides_dir = docs_dir / "guides"
    guides_dir.mkdir()

    (docs_dir / "index.md").write_text(
        "---\ntype: Concept\ntitle: Home\n---\n# Home\nSee [Report](architecture-report.md) and [Guide](guides/core.md).\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (docs_dir / "architecture-report.md").write_text(
        "---\ntype: Concept\ntitle: Report\n---\n# Report\nBack to [Home](index.md).\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (guides_dir / "core.md").write_text(
        "---\ntype: Concept\ntitle: Core Guide\n---\n# Core\nBack to [Home](../index.md).\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    result = runner.invoke(app, ["docs", "build", str(tmp_path), "--no-graph-refresh"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0

    site_dir = tmp_path / ".buddhi" / "site"
    html_files = list(site_dir.rglob("*.html"))
    assert len(html_files) >= 3

    # Crawl all href attributes
    href_re = re.compile(r'href=["\']([^"\']+)["\']')
    broken_links: list[str] = []

    for html_file in html_files:
        content = html_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for href in href_re.findall(content):
            # Skip external links, fragments, mailto
            if href.startswith(("http://", "https://", "mailto:", "#", "javascript:")):
                continue

            # Strip query params and fragment
            clean_target = href.split("?")[0].split("#")[0]
            if not clean_target:
                continue

            target_path = (html_file.parent / clean_target).resolve()
            if not target_path.exists():
                broken_links.append(
                    f"{html_file.relative_to(site_dir)} -> {href} (missing: {target_path})"
                )

    assert len(broken_links) == 0, f"Found broken internal links: {broken_links}"

def test_migrate_legacy_workflows_converts_and_removes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    agents_dir = tmp_path / ".agents"
    workflows_dir = agents_dir / "workflows"
    workflows_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

    # 1. Plain markdown without frontmatter
    (workflows_dir / "plain.md").write_text(
        "# Plain Flow\nRun these steps.\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )

    # 2. Markdown with frontmatter lacking description
    (workflows_dir / "no-desc.md").write_text(
        "---\nversion: 1.0\n---\n# No Desc\nBody.\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )

    # 3. Existing skill that should NOT be overwritten
    skills_dir = agents_dir / "skills" / "already-exists"
    skills_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    existing_skill = skills_dir / "SKILL.md"
    existing_skill.write_text("# Existing Skill Kept\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (workflows_dir / "already-exists.md").write_text(
        "# Old Workflow\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )

    # 4. workflows.json manifest with one item to keep and one to remove
    manifest = agents_dir / "workflows.json"
    manifest.write_text(
        json.dumps([{"name": "plain"}, {"name": "keep-me"}]), encoding="utf-8"
    )

    report = migrate_legacy_workflows(agents_dir)

    assert len(report.migrated) == 2
    assert len(report.skipped_existing) == 1
    assert len(report.removed) == 3

    # Check migrated skills
    plain_skill = agents_dir / "skills" / "plain" / "SKILL.md"
    assert plain_skill.exists()
    plain_text = plain_skill.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "name: plain" in plain_text
    assert "description: Skill for Plain Flow." in plain_text
    assert "# Plain Flow" in plain_text

    no_desc_skill = agents_dir / "skills" / "no-desc" / "SKILL.md"
    assert no_desc_skill.exists()
    no_desc_text = no_desc_skill.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "name: no-desc" in no_desc_text
    assert "description: Custom skill migrated from no-desc." in no_desc_text

    # Check existing preserved
    assert existing_skill.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "# Existing Skill Kept\n"

    # Check workflows directory is completely removed
    assert not workflows_dir.exists()

    # Check manifest cleanup (one kept item remains)
    manifest_data = json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert manifest_data == [{"name": "keep-me"}]

def test_sync_template_tree_skips_init_py_and_pycache(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    src_dir = tmp_path / "src"
    dest_dir = tmp_path / "dest"
    src_dir.mkdir()
    dest_dir.mkdir()

    # The template tree is a Python package: root __init__.py plus a stray
    # __pycache__ dir (present under a pip install, which byte-compiles).
    (src_dir / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (src_dir / "hooks").mkdir()
    (src_dir / "hooks" / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (src_dir / "hooks" / "guard_destructive.py").write_text(
        "print('ok')", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    pycache_dir = src_dir / "__pycache__"
    pycache_dir.mkdir()
    (pycache_dir / "foo.pyc").write_bytes(b"\x00\x01")

    report = sync_template_tree(src_dir, dest_dir)

    assert not (dest_dir / "__init__.py").exists()
    assert not (dest_dir / "hooks" / "__init__.py").exists()
    assert not any(dest_dir.rglob("__pycache__"))
    assert (dest_dir / "hooks" / "guard_destructive.py").exists()
    assert len(report.created) == 1

def test_okf_reader_parses_nested_frontmatter(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

    content = """---
type: Function
title: my_function
description: Computes something critical.
status: stable
tags: [python, core]
generated:
  by: antigravity/model
  at: "2026-10-27T12:00:00Z"
sources:
  - id: src
    resource: src/core.py#L10-L25
    content_hash: 5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99
relations:
  - kind: calls
    target: helper_func
---

# Summary
This is my function.

## Code Example
```python
x = my_function()
```

See [Helper](helper.md) or [External](https://example.com) or [Section](#summary).
"""
    doc_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    reader = OKFMarkdownReader(settings={"PATH": str(tmp_path)})
    html_content, metadata = reader.read(str(doc_path))

    assert metadata["title"] == "my_function"
    assert metadata["summary"] == "Computes something critical."
    assert metadata["okf_status"] == "stable"
    assert metadata["status"] == "published"
    assert metadata["kind"] == "Function"
    assert metadata["tags"] == ["python", "core"]
    assert metadata["generated"]["by"] == "antigravity/model"
    assert len(metadata["sources"]) == 1
    assert metadata["sources"][0]["content_hash"] == "5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99"
    assert metadata["relations"][0]["target"] == "helper_func"

    # HTML rendering and markdown extensions
    assert "This is my function." in html_content
    assert "<code" in html_content

    # Relative .md link should be rewritten to .html
    assert 'href="helper.html"' in html_content
    # External link should remain untouched
    assert 'href="https://example.com"' in html_content
    # Fragment should remain untouched
    assert 'href="#summary"' in html_content

def register(self, label: str) -> str:
        """Register a label and assign it a unique case-deduplicated slug."""
        if label in self.label_to_slug:
            return self.label_to_slug[label]

        base = safe_filename(label, self.limit)
        slug = base
        n = 2
        while slug.lower() in self.used_slugs_lower:
            slug = f"{base}_{n}"
            n += 1

        self.used_slugs_lower.add(slug.lower())
        self.label_to_slug[label] = slug
        return slug

    *,

    git_ref: str | None = None,
    staged: bool = False,
    max_hops: int = 3,
    root_path: Path | None = None,
) -> BlastRadiusReport:
    """Compute the impact radius of modified files or symbols."""
    max_hops = max(1, min(max_hops, 6))
    root = root_path or Path(".")

    target_files: set[str] = set()
    target_node_ids: set[str] = set()

    # 1. Resolve targets from git diff or explicit targets
    if git_ref or staged:
        diff_files = _resolve_git_diff_files(root, git_ref, staged)
        target_files.update(diff_files)
    elif targets:
        for t in targets:
            norm_t = t.replace("\\", "/").strip()
            if "/" in norm_t or norm_t.endswith((".py", ".ts", ".go")):
                target_files.add(norm_t)
            else:
                # Direct symbol name or ID
                cur = conn.cursor()
                cur.execute(
                    "SELECT id, file_path FROM nodes WHERE id = ? OR name = ? OR qualified_name = ?",
                    (norm_t, norm_t, norm_t),
                )

                    target_node_ids.add(nid)
                    if fpath:
                        target_files.add(fpath)
    else:
        # Default: working tree diff against HEAD
        diff_files = _resolve_git_diff_files(root, "HEAD", False)
        target_files.update(diff_files)

    # Resolve target files to symbol node IDs
    if target_files:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in target_files)
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            f"SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE file_path IN ({placeholders}) AND kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method')",
            list(target_files),
        )
        for (nid,) in cur.fetchall():
            target_node_ids.add(nid)

    if not target_node_ids:
        return BlastRadiusReport(
            target_files=sorted(target_files),
            risk_level="low",
        )

    cur.execute("""

            SELECT source_id AS node_id FROM edges WHERE kind IN ('calls', 'inherits') AND resolved = 1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT target_id AS node_id FROM edges WHERE kind IN ('calls', 'inherits') AND resolved = 1
        ) GROUP BY node_id
    """)
    deg_map = dict(cur.fetchall())
    degs = sorted(deg_map.values())
    p99 = degs[int(0.99 * len(degs))] if degs else 50
    hub_thresh = max(50, p99)
    super_hubs = {nid for nid, deg in deg_map.items() if deg > hub_thresh}

    # 3. Hub-Blocked Reverse BFS (find incoming callers/dependents)
    direct_callers: set[str] = set()
    transitive_callers: set[str] = set()
    impacted_god_nodes: set[str] = set()
    visited: set[str] = set(target_node_ids)
    current_frontier = set(target_node_ids)

    actual_hops = 0
    for hop in range(1, max_hops + 1):
        if not current_frontier:
            break
        actual_hops = hop
        next_frontier: set[str] = set()
        p_holders = ",".join("?" for _ in current_frontier)
        cur.execute(
            f"SELECT source_id, target_id FROM edges WHERE target_id IN ({p_holders}) AND kind IN ('calls', 'inherits') AND resolved = 1",
            list(current_frontier),

def compute_sdd_topology_context(
    repo_root: Path,
    targets: list[str] | None = None,
    git_ref: str | None = None,
    staged: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Compute topological summary and blast radius for the active SDD context."""
    db_path = repo_root / ".buddhi" / "graphs" / "tree-graph.db"
    if not db_path.is_file():
        return {
            "status": "no_graph",
            "hint": "Run `buddhi generate` to enable topological context.",
        }

    conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{db_path.resolve().as_posix()}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        report = compute_blast_radius(
            conn,
            targets=targets,
            git_ref=git_ref,
            staged=staged,
            max_hops=3,
            root_path=repo_root,
        )
        gods = get_god_nodes(conn, top_n=5)
        questions = suggest_questions(conn, top_n=5)
        cycles = find_import_cycles(conn, max_cycles=5)
        stats = get_graph_stats(conn, repo_root)

        return {
            "status": "ready",
            "blast_radius": {
                "risk_level": report.risk_level,
                "target_files": report.target_files,
                "target_nodes_count": len(report.target_nodes),
                "direct_callers_count": len(report.direct_callers),
                "transitive_callers_count": len(report.transitive_callers),
                "affected_communities": report.affected_communities,
                "impacted_god_nodes": report.impacted_god_nodes,
            },
            "top_god_nodes": gods,
            "suggested_questions": questions,
            "import_cycles": cycles,
            "graph_stats": stats,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()

def _integrate_file(
    discovered: DiscoveredFile,
    extracted: ExtractedFile,
    ctx: BuildContext,
    source: bytes,
) -> None:
    graph = ctx.graph
    rel_path = discovered.rel_path
    parent_dir = Path(rel_path).parent.as_posix()
    parent_id = dir_node_id(parent_dir) if parent_dir != "." else None

    file_id = file_node_id(rel_path)
    graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id=file_id,
            kind=FILE,
            name=Path(rel_path).name,
            qualified_name=rel_path,
            file_path=rel_path,
            language=discovered.language,
            parent_id=parent_id,
        )
    )
    if parent_id:
        graph.add_edge(
            GraphEdge(
                source=parent_id,
                target=file_id,
                kind=CONTAINS,
                confidence=CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTED,
                confidence_score=1.0,
                context=CONTEXT_CONTAINS,
            )
        )

    symbol_index: dict[str, str] = {}
    used_ids: dict[str, tuple[str, int]] = {}
    def_records: list[_DefRecord] = []
    class_byte_to_id: dict[int, str] = {}

    stack: list[tuple[RawDefinition, str, str, str | None]] = []

    def make_node_id(kind: str, qualified_name: str, start_line: int) -> str:
        base_id = symbol_node_id(kind, rel_path, qualified_name)
        prior = used_ids.get(base_id)
        if prior is None:
            used_ids[base_id] = (rel_path, start_line)
            return base_id
        if prior == (rel_path, start_line):
            return base_id
        return f"{base_id}:L{start_line}"

    for defn in extracted.definitions:
        while stack and stack[-1][0].end_byte <= defn.start_byte:
            stack.pop()

        if defn.receiver_type:
            local_name = f"{defn.receiver_type}.{defn.local_name}"
            kind = METHOD if defn.kind == "function" else defn.kind
        else:
            local_name = defn.local_name
            kind = defn.kind

        if stack:
            _parent_defn, parent_node_id, parent_qualified, parent_class_scope = stack[
                -1
            ]
            qualified_name = f"{parent_qualified}.{local_name}"
            node_parent_id = parent_node_id
            if kind == "function":
                kind = "method"
            class_scope_for_children = parent_class_scope
        else:
            qualified_name = local_name
            node_parent_id = file_id
            class_scope_for_children = None

        node_id = make_node_id(kind, qualified_name, defn.start_line)

        if kind == CLASS:
            class_scope_for_children = node_id
            class_byte_to_id[defn.start_byte] = node_id

        graph.add_node(
            GraphNode(
                id=node_id,
                kind=kind,
                name=defn.local_name,
                qualified_name=qualified_name,
                file_path=rel_path,
                language=discovered.language,
                start_line=defn.start_line,
                end_line=defn.end_line,
                parent_id=node_parent_id,
                snippet=_make_snippet(source, defn.start_byte, defn.end_byte),
            )

def extract_file(source: bytes, spec: LanguageSpec) -> ExtractedFile:
    parser = ts.Parser(spec.language)
    tree = parser.parse(source)

    cursor = ts.QueryCursor(spec.query)
    matches = cursor.matches(tree.root_node)

    definitions: dict[int, RawDefinition] = {}  # keyed by def node start_byte
    imports_by_key: dict[tuple[str, int], RawImport] = {}
    calls: dict[int, RawCall] = {}  # keyed by call node start_byte, prefer richer match
    inheritances: list[RawInheritance] = []

    for _pattern_index, captures in matches:
        def_capture_name = next(
            (name for name in captures if name in _DEFINITION_KIND_MAP), None
        )
        if def_capture_name is not None:
            def_node = captures[def_capture_name][0]
            name_nodes = captures.get("name")
            if not name_nodes:
                continue
            local_name = _node_text(name_nodes[0])
            receiver_nodes = captures.get("receiver.type")
            receiver_type = (
                _clean_receiver_type(_node_text(receiver_nodes[0]))
                if receiver_nodes
                else None
            )
            kind = _DEFINITION_KIND_MAP[def_capture_name]
            existing = definitions.get(def_node.start_byte)
            candidate = RawDefinition(
                kind=kind,
                local_name=local_name,
                receiver_type=receiver_type,
                start_line=def_node.start_point[0] + 1,
                end_line=def_node.end_point[0] + 1,
                start_byte=def_node.start_byte,
                end_byte=def_node.end_byte,
            )
            if existing is None or (receiver_type and not existing.receiver_type):
                definitions[def_node.start_byte] = candidate

            if "inherit.base" in captures:
                for base_node in captures["inherit.base"]:
                    base_text = _node_text(base_node).strip()
                    if base_text:
                        inheritances.append(
                            RawInheritance(
                                class_start_byte=def_node.start_byte,
                                base_name=base_text,
                                start_line=base_node.start_point[0] + 1,
                            )
                        )
            continue

        if "import" in captures and "import.path" in captures:
            path_node = captures["import.path"][0]
            clean_path = _clean_import_text(_node_text(path_node))
            line_no = path_node.start_point[0] + 1
            key = (clean_path, line_no)
            if key not in imports_by_key:
                imports_by_key[key] = RawImport(
                    path_text=clean_path, start_line=line_no
                )

            if "import.symbol" in captures:
                for sym_node in captures["import.symbol"]:
                    sym_name = _node_text(sym_node).strip()
                    if sym_name and sym_name not in imports_by_key[key].imported_names:
                        imports_by_key[key].imported_names.append(sym_name)
            continue

        if "call" in captures and "call.name" in captures:
            call_node = captures["call"][0]
            name_text = _node_text(captures["call.name"][0])
            receiver_nodes = captures.get("call.receiver")
            receiver_text = _node_text(receiver_nodes[0]) if receiver_nodes else None
            existing_call = calls.get(call_node.start_byte)
            candidate_call = RawCall(
                name=name_text,
                receiver=receiver_text,
                node_start_byte=call_node.start_byte,
                start_line=call_node.start_point[0] + 1,
            )
            if existing_call is None or (receiver_text and not existing_call.receiver):
                calls[call_node.start_byte] = candidate_call

    return ExtractedFile(
        definitions=sorted(definitions.values(), key=lambda d: d.start_byte),
        imports=list

def build_graph(
    walk_result: WalkResult,
    existing_cache: dict[str, tuple[str, str, str, str]] | None = None,
) -> BuildContext:
    ctx = BuildContext()
    _add_directory_nodes(ctx, walk_result)

    files_parsed = 0
    files_failed = 0
    cache_hits = 0
    now_iso = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    for discovered in walk_result.files:
        spec = get_spec(discovered.language)
        if spec is None:
            files_failed += 1
            ctx.warnings.append(
                f"no grammar available for {discovered.language}: {discovered.rel_path}"
            )
            continue

        try:
            source = discovered.abs_path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            files_failed += 1
            ctx.warnings.append(f"could not read {discovered.rel_path}: {exc}")
            continue

        file_sha = compute_sha256(source)
        extracted: ExtractedFile | None = None

        if existing_cache and discovered.rel_path in existing_cache:
            c_sha, c_lang, c_payload, c_updated = existing_cache[discovered.rel_path]
            if c_sha == file_sha and c_lang == discovered.language:
                try:
                    payload_dict = deserialize_extraction_payload(c_payload)
                    extracted = ExtractedFile.from_dict(payload_dict)
                    cache_hits += 1
                    ctx.extract_cache_entries.append(
                        (discovered.rel_path, c_sha, c_lang, c_payload, c_updated)
                    )
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
                    extracted = None

        if extracted is None:
            try:
                extracted = extract_file(source, spec)
                payload_json = serialize_extraction_payload(extracted.to_dict())
                ctx.extract_cache_entries.append(
                    (
                        discovered.rel_path,
                        file_sha,
                        discovered.language,
                        payload_json,
                        now_iso,
                    )
                )
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                files_failed += 1
                ctx.warnings.append(f"failed to parse {discovered.rel_path}: {exc}")
                continue

        if extracted.parse_had_errors:
            ctx.warnings.append(
                f"parsed with syntax errors (best-effort): {discovered.rel_path}"
            )

        files_parsed += 1
        _integrate_file(discovered, extracted, ctx, source)

    ctx.stats["files_parsed"] = files_parsed
    ctx.stats["files_failed"] = files_failed
    ctx.stats["cache_hits"] = cache_hits
    ctx.stats["node_count"] = len(ctx.graph.nodes)
    return ctx

def run_pipeline(root: Path, max_file_size: int = 2_000_000) -> PipelineResult:
    """Walk `root`, build the code graph, resolve edges, and cluster it."""
    lang_status = available_languages()
    avail = {lang for lang, err in lang_status.items() if err is None}
    language_warnings = {
        lang: err for lang, err in lang_status.items() if err is not None
    }

    walk_result = walk(root, max_file_size=max_file_size, available_languages=avail)

    db_path = root / ".buddhi" / "graphs" / "tree-graph.db"
    existing_cache = load_extract_cache(db_path) if db_path.is_file() else None

    build_ctx = build_graph(walk_result, existing_cache=existing_cache)
    resolve(build_ctx)
    community_count = assign_communities(build_ctx.graph)
    build_ctx.graph.built_at_commit = get_git_head_sha(root)

    return PipelineResult(
        root=root,
        walk_result=walk_result,
        build_ctx=build_ctx,
        community_count=community_count,
        language_warnings=language_warnings,
    )

def _prepare_directories_and_graph(
    root: Path,
    no_graph_refresh: bool = False,
    max_file_size: int = 2_000_000,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> CodeGraph | None:
    """Ensure .buddhi dirs exist and graph artifacts are initialized."""
    try:
        graphs_dir = ensure_buddhi_dirs(root)
        ensure_docs_dir(root)
        ensure_site_dir(root)
    except BuddhiFsError as exc:
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] {exc}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc

    db_path = graphs_dir / "tree-graph.db"
    html_path = graphs_dir / "tree-graph.html"
    json_path = graphs_dir / "tree-graph.json"

    graph: CodeGraph | None = None
    if not no_graph_refresh or not db_path.exists() or not html_path.exists():
        result = run_pipeline(root, max_file_size=max_file_size)
        graph = result.build_ctx.graph
        if verbose:
            for warning in result.build_ctx.warnings:
                err_console.print(f"[yellow]warning:[/yellow] {warning}")
        try:
            write_json(result.build_ctx.graph, json_path)
            write_sqlite(
                result.build_ctx.graph,
                db_path,
                root_path=str(root),
                extract_cache_entries=result.build_ctx.extract_cache_entries,
            )
            write_html(
                result.build_ctx.graph,
                html_path,
                root_label=root.name or str(root),
            )
        except OSError as exc:
            err_console.print(
                f"[yellow]warning:[/yellow] failed writing graph artifacts: {exc}"
            )

    return graph

def compile_site(
    root: Path,
    output_dir: Path | None = None,
    theme_dir: Path | None = None,
    graph: CodeGraph | None = None,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> Path:
    """Compile OKF documentation under .buddhi/docs/ into static HTML via Pelican."""
    docs_dir = root / ".buddhi" / "docs"
    out = (output_dir or root / ".buddhi" / "site").resolve()
    docs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 0. Synthesize graph-grounded OKF markdown bundle if database exists
    generate_docs_bundle(root, graph=graph)

    # 1. Read / prepare settings
    sitename = f"{root.name} Documentation"
    settings = get_pelican_settings(
        docs_dir=docs_dir,
        output_dir=out,
        sitename=sitename,
        theme_dir=theme_dir,
    )

    # 2. Run Pelican
    pelican = Pelican(settings=settings)
    pelican.run()

    # 3. Emit search index
    generate_search_index(docs_dir, out)

    # 4. Copy interactive code graph
    copy_interactive_graph(root, out)

    return out

def serve_docs(
    root: Path,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 8000,
    reload: bool = True,
    open_browser: bool = True,
    output_dir: Path | None = None,
    theme_dir: Path | None = None,
    graph: CodeGraph | None = None,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Compile and serve documentation locally with live reload."""
    out = (output_dir or root / ".buddhi" / "site").resolve()

    # Compile initial site
    compile_site(
        root, output_dir=out, theme_dir=theme_dir, graph=graph, verbose=verbose
    )

    if not is_port_available(host, port):
        raise OSError(
            f"Port {port} on {host} is already in use. Please specify another port with --port."
        )

    reloader = None
    if reload:
        reloader = LiveReloader(root, out)
        reloader.start()

    server_address = (host, port)
    httpd = RootedHTTPServer(str(out), server_address, BuddhiHTTPRequestHandler)

    url = f"http://{host}:{port}/"
    print(f"Serving documentation at {url}")
    print("Press Ctrl+C to stop the server.")

    if open_browser:
        webbrowser.open(url)

    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nStopping documentation server.")
    finally:
        if reloader:
            reloader.stop()
        httpd.server_close()

def _create_test_db(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    graph = CodeGraph()
    # Nodes
    graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="file:a.py",
            kind="file",
            name="a.py",
            qualified_name="a.py",
            file_path="a.py",
        )
    )
    graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="file:b.py",
            kind="file",
            name="b.py",
            qualified_name="b.py",
            file_path="b.py",
        )
    )
    graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="function:a.py::caller",
            kind="function",
            name="caller",
            qualified_name="caller",
            file_path="a.py",
            community_id=1,
        )
    )
    graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="function:b.py::target",
            kind="function",
            name="target",
            qualified_name="target",
            file_path="b.py",
            community_id=2,
        )
    )
    graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="function:b.py::god_hub",
            kind="function",
            name="god_hub",
            qualified_name="god_hub",
            file_path="b.py",
            community_id=2,
        )
    )

    # Edges
    graph.add_edge(GraphEdge(source="file:a.py", target="file:b.py", kind=IMPORTS))
    graph.add_edge(
        GraphEdge(
            source="function:a.py::caller",
            target="function:b.py::target",
            kind=CALLS,
            confidence="EXTRACTED",
        )
    )
    graph.add_edge(
        GraphEdge(
            source="function:a.py::caller",
            target="function:b.py::god_hub",
            kind=CALLS,
            confidence="INFERRED",
        )
    )
    graph.add_edge(
        GraphEdge(
            source="function:b.py::target",
            target="function:b.py::god_hub",
            kind=CALLS,
            confidence="EXTRACTED",
        )
    )

    graph.communities[1] = CommunityInfo(
        id=1, label="a_comm", node_count=1, cohesion=1.0
    )
    graph.communities[2] = CommunityInfo(
        id=2, label="b_comm", node_count=2, cohesion=0.8
    )
    graph.built_at_commit = "abcd" * 10

    db_path = tmp_path / "tree-graph.db"
    write_sqlite(graph, db_path, root_path=str(tmp_path))
    return db_path

def test_resolve_cross_file_calls_with_named_imports() -> None:
    from buddhi.graph.builder import BuildContext, PendingCall, PendingImport
    from buddhi.graph.model import (
        CALLS,
        CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTED,
        FUNCTION,
        CodeGraph,
        GraphNode,
    )
    from buddhi.graph.resolver import resolve

    ctx = BuildContext(graph=CodeGraph())
    # File 1: helper.py with compute()
    ctx.graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="file:helper.py",
            kind="file",
            name="helper.py",
            qualified_name="helper.py",
            file_path="helper.py",
        )
    )
    ctx.graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="function:helper.py::compute",
            kind=FUNCTION,
            name="compute",
            qualified_name="compute",
            file_path="helper.py",
        )
    )

    # File 2: main.py imports compute from helper and calls it
    ctx.graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="file:main.py",
            kind="file",
            name="main.py",
            qualified_name="main.py",
            file_path="main.py",
        )
    )
    ctx.graph.add_node(
        GraphNode(
            id="function:main.py::run",
            kind=FUNCTION,
            name="run",
            qualified_name="run",
            file_path="main.py",
        )
    )

    ctx.pending_imports.append(
        PendingImport(
            source_id="file:main.py",
            importing_file_rel="main.py",
            language="python",
            path_text="helper",
            line=1,
            imported_names=["compute"],
        )
    )
    ctx.pending_calls.append(
        PendingCall(
            source_id="function:main.py::run",
            enclosing_class_id=None,
            importing_file_rel="main.py",
            call_name="compute",
            receiver=None,
            line=2,
        )
    )

    resolve(ctx)
    call_edges = [e for e in ctx.graph.edges if e.kind == CALLS]
    assert len(call_edges) == 1
    assert call_edges[0].target == "function:helper.py::compute"
    assert call_edges[0].resolved is True
    assert call_edges[0].confidence == CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTED
    assert call_edges[0].confidence_score >= 0.9

    write_sqlite(_sample_graph(), db_path, root_path=str(tmp_path))

            UNION ALL
            SELECT n.id, n.parent_id, a.depth + 1

def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> MemoryFrontmatter:
        # Resolve kind
        raw_kind = data.get("kind", MemoryKind.CONVENTION.value)
        try:
            kind_enum = MemoryKind(raw_kind)
        except ValueError:
            kind_enum = MemoryKind.CONVENTION

        # Resolve status
        raw_status = data.get("status", MemoryStatus.STABLE.value)
        try:
            status_enum = MemoryStatus(raw_status)
        except ValueError:
            status_enum = MemoryStatus.STABLE

        # Resolve confidence
        raw_conf = data.get("confidence", MemoryConfidence.VERIFIED.value)
        try:
            conf_enum = MemoryConfidence(raw_conf)
        except ValueError:
            conf_enum = MemoryConfidence.VERIFIED

        raw_gen = data.get("generated")
        generated = (
            MemoryGenerated.from_dict(raw_gen)
            if isinstance(raw_gen, dict)
            else MemoryGenerated()
        )

        raw_sources = data.get("sources", [])
        sources = [
            MemorySource.from_dict(s) for s in raw_sources if isinstance(s, dict)
        ]

        raw_relations = data.get("relations", [])
        relations = [
            MemoryRelation.from_dict(r) for r in raw_relations if isinstance(r, dict)
        ]

        raw_paths = data.get("paths", [])
        paths = [str(p) for p in raw_paths] if isinstance(raw_paths, list) else []

        raw_tags = data.get("tags", [])
        tags = [str(t) for t in raw_tags] if isinstance(raw_tags, list) else []

        return cls(
            id=str(data.get("id", "")),
            kind=kind_enum,
            title=str(data.get("title", "")),
            summary=str(data.get("summary", "")),
            status=status_enum,
            confidence=conf_enum,
            scope=str(data.get("scope", "project")),
            paths=paths,
            tags=tags,
            generated=generated,
            sources=sources,
            relations=relations,
        )

def test_staleness_detection(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ws = tmp_path / "workspace"
    ws.mkdir()
    code_file = ws / "module.py"
    code_file.write_text("line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n", encoding="utf-8")

    initial_hash = compute_content_hash(ws, "module.py#L2-L2")
    source = MemorySource(
        id="src", resource="module.py#L2-L2", content_hash=initial_hash
    )

    # Initial check: not stale
    res = verify_source_staleness(ws, source)
    assert not res.is_stale

    # Mutate line 1 (outside slice): should still NOT be stale
    code_file.write_text("MODIFIED line 1\nline 2\nline 3\n", encoding="utf-8")
    res = verify_source_staleness(ws, source)
    assert not res.is_stale

    # Mutate line 2 (inside slice): should become stale
    code_file.write_text("MODIFIED line 1\nMODIFIED line 2\nline 3\n", encoding="utf-8")
    res = verify_source_staleness(ws, source)
    assert res.is_stale
    assert res.reason == "hash_mismatch"

    # Delete file: should report file_not_found
    code_file.unlink()
    res = verify_source_staleness(ws, source)
    assert res.is_stale
    assert res.reason == "file_not_found"

def sync_indexes(self, scope: str = "project") -> None:
        """Regenerate topic index.md files and root MEMORY.md."""
        base_dir = self.get_scope_dir(scope)
        nodes = self.list_nodes(scopes=[scope])

        # 1. Update topic index.md files
        topic_nodes: dict[str, list[MemoryNode]] = {t: [] for t in TOPIC_DIRS.values()}
        for node in nodes:
            topic_sub = TOPIC_DIRS.get(node.kind.value, "misc")
            topic_nodes.setdefault(topic_sub, []).append(node)

        for topic, t_nodes in topic_nodes.items():
            topic_dir = base_dir / topic
            topic_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            lines = [f"# {topic.capitalize()} Index\n"]
            for n in sorted(t_nodes, key=lambda x: x.title.lower()):
                rel_path = f"{n.id}.md"
                clean_sum = n.summary.strip().replace("\n", " ")
                lines.append(f"* [{n.title}]({rel_path}) - {clean_sum}")
            (topic_dir / "index.md").write_text(
                "\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
            )

        # 2. Update MEMORY.md index entrypoint
        # Prioritize STABLE & VERIFIED nodes, demoting SUPERSEDED or lowest confidence if budget exceeds
        sorted_nodes = sorted(
            nodes,
            key=lambda n: (
                0 if n.frontmatter.status == MemoryStatus.STABLE else 1,
                0 if n.frontmatter.confidence == MemoryConfidence.VERIFIED else 1,
                n.title.lower(),
            ),
        )

        header_lines = [
            "---",
            'okf_version: "0.2"',
            "---",
            "",
            "# Memory Index",
            "",
        ]

        pointer_lines: list[str] = []
        for n in sorted_nodes:
            # Demote superseded or deprecated from top-level MEMORY.md if approaching budget
            if n.frontmatter.status in (
                MemoryStatus.DEPRECATED,
                MemoryStatus.SUPERSEDED,
            ):
                continue
            topic_sub = TOPIC_DIRS.get(n.kind.value, "misc")
            rel_link = f"{topic_sub}/{n.id}.md"
            summary_avail = MAX_LINE_CHARS - len(f"* [{n.title}]({rel_link}) - ") - 5
            truncated_summary = n.summary.strip().replace("\n", " ")[
                : max(10, summary_avail)
            ]
            pointer = f"* [{n.title}]({rel_link}) - {truncated_summary}"
            pointer_lines.append(pointer[:MAX_LINE_CHARS])

        # Slice to ensure <= 200 lines total
        allowed_pointers = MAX_MEMORY_LINES - len(header_lines) - 2
        final_pointers = pointer_lines[:allowed_pointers]

        content = "\n".join(header_lines + final_pointers) + "\n"
        (base_dir / "MEMORY.md").write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

def migrate_legacy_memory(workspace_root: Path) -> MigrationResult:
    """Migrates legacy flat topic files in .agents/memory/ to OKF concept nodes."""
    memory_dir = workspace_root / ".agents" / "memory"
    if not memory_dir.is_dir():
        return MigrationResult()

    store = MemoryStore(workspace_root)
    store.init_bundle("project")

    result = MigrationResult()

    for legacy_name, kind in LEGACY_FILES_MAP.items():
        legacy_path = memory_dir / legacy_name
        if not legacy_path.is_file():
            continue

        text = legacy_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        entries = parse_legacy_entries(text)

        for idx, entry in enumerate(entries, 1):
            # Extract first sentence or up to 50 chars as title
            title_match = re.split(r"[.!?]\s+", entry, maxsplit=1)
            title = title_match[0].strip() if title_match else entry[:50]
            if len(title) > 60:
                title = title[:57] + "..."

            slug = sanitize_slug(title)
            node_id = f"mem-{kind.value}-{slug}"

            node = MemoryNode(
                frontmatter=MemoryFrontmatter(
                    id=node_id,
                    kind=kind,
                    title=title,
                    summary=entry[:140],
                    status=MemoryStatus.STABLE,
                    confidence=MemoryConfidence.VERIFIED,
                    scope="project",
                    tags=["migrated-legacy"],
                    generated=MemoryGenerated(by="buddhi-cli/migrate"),
                ),
                body=f"# Context & Rationale\n\n{entry}\n",
            )
            saved_path = store.save_node(node, "project")
            result.created_nodes.append(saved_path)
            result.migrated_count += 1

        # Backup legacy file as .md.bak
        backup_path = memory_dir / f"{legacy_name}.bak"
        legacy_path.rename(backup_path)
        result.backed_up_files.append(backup_path)

    if result.migrated_count > 0:
        store.log_mutation(
            scope="project",
            action="migrated",
            node_id="legacy-bundle",
            title=f"Migrated {result.migrated_count} legacy memory entries to OKF concepts",
        )
        store.sync_indexes("project")

    return result

def init(
    path: Path = typer.Argument(Path("."), help="Root directory to initialize."),  # noqa: B008
    max_file_size: int = typer.Option(
        2_000_000, "--max-file-size", help="Skip files larger than this, in bytes."
    ),
    verbose: bool = typer.Option(
        False, "-v", "--verbose", help="Print per-file warnings."
    ),
) -> None:
    """Build the code graph, plan docs, and scaffold a Google Antigravity agent harness.

    The harness covers doc generation plus a general full-stack planning layer
    (frontend/backend/database/testing/security/deployment/git specialist
    agents, orchestrated by the /spec-plan skill). Idempotent: rerunning never
    overwrites a harness file you've already created or edited under .agents/
    — it only fills in what's missing.
    """
    root = path.resolve()

    if not root.exists():
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] path does not exist: {root}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
    if not root.is_dir():
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] not a directory: {root}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)

    # Render branded ASCII art banner
    render_banner(console)

    result = run_pipeline(root, max_file_size=max_file_size)
    if verbose:
        for lang, err in result.language_warnings.items():
            err_console.print(
                f"[yellow]warning:[/yellow] language '{lang}' unavailable: {err}"
            )
        for warning in result.build_ctx.warnings:
            err_console.print(f"[yellow]warning:[/yellow] {warning}")

    try:
        graphs_dir = ensure_buddhi_dirs(root)
        ensure_docs_dir(root)
    except BuddhiFsError as exc:
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] {exc}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc

    json_path = graphs_dir / "tree-graph.json"
    db_path = graphs_dir / "tree-graph.db"
    html_path = graphs_dir / "tree-graph.html"

    try:
        write_json(result.build_ctx.graph, json_path)
        write_sqlite(
            result.build_ctx.graph,
            db_path,
            root_path=str(root),
            extract_cache_entries=result.build_ctx.extract_cache_entries,
        )
        write_html(result.build_ctx.graph, html_path, root_label=root.name or str(root))
    except OSError as exc:
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] failed writing graph artifacts: {exc}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1) from exc

    plan_entries = build_docs_plan(result.build_ctx.graph, root)
    plan_path = root / ".buddhi" / "docs-plan.json"
    try:
        plan_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(plan_to_json(plan_entries), indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
    except OSError as exc:
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] failed writing {plan_path}: {exc}")

def test_memory_store_budget_and_compaction(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    store = MemoryStore(tmp_path)
    store.init_bundle("project")

    # Add 10 valid nodes
    for i in range(10):
        node = MemoryNode(
            frontmatter=MemoryFrontmatter(
                id=f"mem-decision-{i}",
                kind=MemoryKind.DECISION,
                title=f"Decision {i}",
                summary=f"This is decision summary number {i} with valuable rationale.",
                status=MemoryStatus.STABLE,
                confidence=MemoryConfidence.VERIFIED,
            ),
            body="# Details\n\nSome body text.",
        )
        store.save_node(node, "project")

    budget = store.check_budget("project")
    assert budget.is_valid
    assert budget.total_lines < 200
    assert budget.total_bytes < 25600

    # Add a superseded node
    superseded = MemoryNode(
        frontmatter=MemoryFrontmatter(
            id="mem-decision-old",
            kind=MemoryKind.DECISION,
            title="Old Decision",
            summary="This was superseded.",
            status=MemoryStatus.SUPERSEDED,
            confidence=MemoryConfidence.PROPOSED,

        body="Old text",

    content = memory_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "Decision 9" in content
    assert "Old Decision" not in content  # Pruned from top index

    # But it IS present in decisions/index.md
    decisions_index = tmp_path / ".agents" / "memory" / "decisions" / "index.md"
    d_content = decisions_index.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

def autoharness_validate_cmd(
    skill_path: Annotated[
        Path, typer.Argument(help="Path to skill directory or SKILL.md file.")
    ],
) -> None:
    """Validate a skill against the 6 deterministic AutoHarness admission gates."""
    from buddhi.scripts.autoharness.models import SkillIntent
    from buddhi.scripts.autoharness.sidecar import is_agent_created
    from buddhi.scripts.autoharness.validate import validate_skill_candidate

    target_dir = skill_path if skill_path.is_dir() else skill_path.parent
    skill_file = target_dir / "SKILL.md"
    if not skill_file.is_file():
        err_console.print(f"[red]error:[/red] cannot find SKILL.md at {target_dir}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)

    body = skill_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    intent = SkillIntent(
        action="update",
        name=target_dir.name,
        layer="project",
        body=body,
        reason="Manual validation",
        evidence="Manual validation",
    )
    agents_dir = target_dir.parent.parent
    val_res = validate_skill_candidate(
        intent=intent,
        assembled_body=body,
        target_is_agent_created=is_agent_created(target_dir),
        target_exists=True,
        layer_root=agents_dir,
    )

    if val_res.valid:
        console.print(
            f"[bold green]pass:[/bold green] skill '{target_dir.name}' passes all 6 admission gates."
        )
        raise typer.Exit(code=0)
    else:
        err_console.print(
            f"[bold red]fail:[/bold red] skill '{target_dir.name}' has {len(val_res.findings)} gate violation(s):"
        )
        for f in val_res.findings:
            err_console.print(f"  - [{f.gate}] {f.code}: {f.message}")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)

def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> FilterSpec:
        replace_raw = data.get("replace", [])
        replace_rules = [
            ReplaceRule(pattern=r["pattern"], replacement=r.get("replacement", ""))
            for r in replace_raw
            if isinstance(r, dict) and "pattern" in r
        ]

        match_output_raw = data.get("match_output", [])
        match_output_rules = [
            MatchOutputRule(
                pattern=m["pattern"],
                message=m.get("message", ""),
                unless=m.get("unless"),
            )
            for m in match_output_raw
            if isinstance(m, dict) and "pattern" in m and "message" in m
        ]

        tests_raw = data.get("tests", [])
        tests = [
            FilterTestCase(
                name=t.get("name", ""),
                input=t.get("input", ""),
                expected=t.get("expected", ""),
            )
            for t in tests_raw
            if isinstance(t, dict)
        ]

        error_pats = data.get("error_patterns")
        if error_pats is None:
            error_patterns = list(DEFAULT_ERROR_PATTERNS)
        else:
            error_patterns = list(error_pats)

        return cls(
            name=data.get("name", "unnamed"),
            description=data.get("description", ""),
            match_command=data.get("match_command", ""),
            strip_ansi=data.get("strip_ansi", True),
            strip_lines_matching=list(data.get("strip_lines_matching", [])),
            keep_lines_matching=list(data.get("keep_lines_matching", [])),
            error_patterns=error_patterns,
            replace_rules=replace_rules,
            match_output=match_output_rules,
            max_lines=data.get("max_lines"),
            head_lines=data.get("head_lines"),
            tail_lines=data.get("tail_lines"),
            truncate_lines_at=data.get("truncate_lines_at"),
            dedup=data.get("dedup", False),
            on_empty=data.get("on_empty"),
            tests=tests,
            source=data.get("source", ""),
            license=data.get("license", "Apache-2.0"),

        )

    apply_registers(
        root,
        src_dir,
        resolved.exceptions_path,
        resolved.decisions_path,
        findings,
    )

    if gate_declared is not None:
        errors_found = sum(1 for f in findings if f.level == "ERROR")
        if re.search(r"NOT RUN|N[ÃA]O RODOU", gate_declared, re.IGNORECASE):
            findings.append(
                GateFinding(
                    "WARN",
                    "gate-declared",
                    "REPORT.md declares the static gate NOT RUN, but it is running now — record this run's outcome instead.",
                )
            )
        elif re.search(r"\bPASS\b", gate_declared, re.IGNORECASE) and errors_found:
            findings.append(
                GateFinding(
                    "ERROR",
                    "gate-declared",
                    f"REPORT.md declares the static gate PASS, but this run found {errors_found} error(s). Record the real outcome.",
                )
            )

    errors = [f for f in findings if f.level == "ERROR"]
    warnings = [f for f in findings if f.level == "WARN"]
    registered = [f for f in findings if f.level == "REGISTERED"]

    also = f", {len(registered)} registered" if registered else ""
    verdict = "FAIL" if errors else "PASS"
    today_iso = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).date().isoformat()
    summary_line = (
        f"Record in REPORT.md → Static gate (verify-a11y.py): {verdict} "
        f"({len(errors)} error(s), {len(warnings)} warning(s){also}) — run on: {today_iso}"
    )

    out_lines = []
    for f in errors + warnings + registered:
        marker = {"ERROR": "✗", "WARN": "!"}.get(f.level, "·")
        out_lines.append(f"{marker} [{f.check}] {f.message}")

    out_lines.append("")
    if errors:
        out_lines.append(
            f"FAIL — {len(errors)} error(s), {len(warnings)} warning(s){also}."
        )
    elif warnings or registered:
        out_lines.append(f"PASS with {len(warnings)} warning(s){also}.")
    else:
        out_lines.append("PASS — nothing statically detectable is wrong.")
    out_lines.append(
        "This is not a conformance claim: the human checkpoints in REPORT.md are what establish it."
    )

    exit_code = 0 if (not errors or warn_only) else 1

        registered=registered,

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Inspect repository facts and create or update AGENTS.md."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--root",
        "-r",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("."),
        help="Project root directory (default: current directory).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--diff",
        "-d",
        action="store_true",
        help="Display unified diff against existing AGENTS.md without modifying it.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--apply",
        "-a",
        action="store_true",
        help="Apply changes and write AGENTS.md directly.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        "-j",
        action="store_true",
        help="Output detected facts and merge results as JSON.",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()

    if not root.is_dir():
        print(f"Error: target root '{root}' is not a directory.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    agents_md_path = root / "AGENTS.md"
    facts = detect_repo_facts(root)

    existing_content = ""
    is_new = not agents_md_path.is_file()
    if not is_new:
        try:
            existing_content = agents_md_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            print(f"Error reading {agents_md_path}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

    if is_new:
        generated_content = generate_agents_md(facts)
        has_changes = True
        diff_output = diff_agents_md("", generated_content)
        updated_sections = [
            "# AGENTS.md",
            "## Commands",
            "## Agent Conventions & Skills",
        ]
        preserved_sections: list[str] = []
        final_content = generated_content
    else:
        merge_res = merge_agents_md(existing_content, facts)
        has_changes = merge_res.has_changes
        diff_output = merge_res.diff
        updated_sections = merge_res.updated_sections
        preserved_sections = merge_res.preserved_sections
        final_content = merge_res.content

    if args.json:
        payload = {
            "root": str(root),
            "is_new": is_new,
            "has_changes": has_changes,
            "facts": {
                "name": facts.name,
                "description": facts.description,
                "primary_language": facts.primary_language,
                "commands": facts.commands.as_dict(),
                "skills": facts.skills,
                "has_rules": facts.has_rules,
                "has_buddhi_docs": facts.has_buddhi_docs,
            },
            "updated_sections": updated_sections,
            "preserved_sections": preserved_sections,
            "diff": diff_output,
        }
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
        return 0

    if args.apply:
        try:
            agents_md_path.write_text(final_content, encoding="utf-8")
            status_str = "Created" if is_new else "Updated"
            print(f"{status_str} {agents_md_path} successfully.")
            return 0
        except OSError as exc:
            print(f"Error writing {agents_md_path}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

    if args.diff:
        if is_new:
            print(f"--- /dev/null\n+++ {agents_md_path}\n")
            print(final_content)
        elif has_changes:
            print(diff_output)
        else:
            print("AGENTS.md is up-to-date. Zero changes needed.")
        return 0

    # Default summary mode
    print(f"Target: {root}")
    print(f"Primary Language: {facts.primary_language}")
    print("Commands Detected:")
    for k, v in facts.commands.as_dict().items():
        if v:
            print(f"  - {k.capitalize()}: {v}")
    if is_new:
        print(
            "\nAGENTS.md does not exist. Run with --apply to create it, or --diff to preview."
        )
    elif has_changes:
        print(
            "\nChanges detected in AGENTS.md. Run with --diff to inspect, or --apply to update."
        )

def detect_design_facts(root: Path | None = None) -> DesignFacts:
    """Analyze a repository and extract design tokens and facts."""
    base = Path(root or Path.cwd()).resolve()
    name = base.name

    tokens = _default_neutral_tokens()
    has_ui_surface = False
    framework: str | None = None
    source_files: list[str] = []

    # 1. Look for package.json indicators
    pkg_json = base / "package.json"
    if pkg_json.is_file():
        try:
            pkg = json.loads(pkg_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
            deps = {**pkg.get("dependencies", {}), **pkg.get("devDependencies", {})}
            if "tailwindcss" in deps:
                framework = "tailwind"
                has_ui_surface = True
            elif any(k in deps for k in ("react", "vue", "svelte", "next", "nuxt")):
                framework = "component-library"
                has_ui_surface = True
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
            pass

    # 2. Look for Tailwind configuration files
    for tw_name in (
        "tailwind.config.js",
        "tailwind.config.ts",
        "tailwind.config.mjs",
        "tailwind.config.cjs",
    ):
        tw_path = base / tw_name
        if tw_path.is_file():
            has_ui_surface = True
            framework = "tailwind"
            source_files.append(tw_name)
            _scan_tailwind_config(tw_path, tokens)

    # 3. Look for token JSON files
    for tok_name in (
        "tokens.json",
        "design-tokens.json",
        "theme.json",
        "tokens/tokens.json",
    ):
        tok_path = base / tok_name
        if tok_path.is_file():
            has_ui_surface = True
            framework = framework or "dtcg"
            source_files.append(tok_name)
            _scan_token_json(tok_path, tokens)

    # 4. Search for CSS / SCSS stylesheets (limit walk depth/count)
    file_count = 0
    for path in base.rglob("*"):
        if file_count > 500:
            break
        if any(part in _EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in path.parts):
            continue
        if path.is_file():
            file_count += 1
            if path.suffix.lower() in _CSS_EXTS:
                has_ui_surface = True
                framework = framework or "css"
                try:
                    rel_p = str(path.relative_to(base))
                    source_files.append(rel_p)
                except ValueError:
                    source_files.append(str(path))

        has_ui_surface=has_ui_surface,
        framework=framework,
        source_files=source_files[:10],
        tokens=tokens,
    )

def test_linter_wcag_contrast_pass_and_fail(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # 1. Compliant content (black text on white surface -> ratio 21:1)
    good_facts = detect_design_facts(tmp_path)
    good_facts.tokens.colors = {
        "background": "#ffffff",
        "surface": "#ffffff",
        "text": "#000000",
        "primary": "#000000",
        "primary-foreground": "#ffffff",
    }
    good_md = generate_design_md(good_facts)
    report = lint_design_md(good_md)
    assert report.is_valid is True
    assert len(report.errors) == 0

    # 2. Failing contrast (light grey text on white surface -> ratio < 4.5:1)
    bad_facts = detect_design_facts(tmp_path)
    bad_facts.tokens.colors = {
        "background": "#ffffff",
        "surface": "#ffffff",
        "text": "#cccccc",
        "primary": "#cccccc",
        "primary-foreground": "#ffffff",
    }
    bad_md = generate_design_md(bad_facts)
    bad_report = lint_design_md(bad_md)
    assert bad_report.is_valid is False
    failing_pairs = [f for f in bad_report.contrast_findings if f.status == "FAIL"]
    assert len(failing_pairs) > 0

def buddhi_memory(
    action: Annotated[
        str, "Memory operation: 'search', 'read', 'remember', or 'status'"
    ],
    query: Annotated[str | None, "Search query (keywords, concept title, tags)"] = None,
    kind: Annotated[
        str | None,
        "Filter or set concept kind: decision, convention, preference, feedback, sdd-rationale",
    ] = None,
    scope: Annotated[
        str, "Memory scope: 'project', 'local', 'user', or 'agent:<name>'"
    ] = "project",
    active_files: Annotated[
        list[str] | None,
        "List of currently active file paths for path-scoped glob matching",
    ] = None,
    node_id: Annotated[
        str | None,
        "Exact memory concept ID to read or update (e.g. 'mem-decision-sqlite-wal')",
    ] = None,
    title: Annotated[str | None, "Concept title (required for 'remember')"] = None,
    summary: Annotated[
        str | None, "One-sentence concept summary (required for 'remember')"
    ] = None,
    body: Annotated[
        str | None, "Markdown body detailing context, rationale, and invariants"
    ] = None,
    path_globs: Annotated[
        list[str] | None,
        "Glob patterns when this memory activates (e.g. ['src/api/**/*.py'])",
    ] = None,
    sources: Annotated[
        list[str] | None,
        "Code provenance anchors to hash and track staleness (e.g. ['src/api/auth.py#L10-L40'])",
    ] = None,
    tags: Annotated[list[str] | None, "Classification tags"] = None,
    expand_imports: Annotated[
        bool, "Expand @path imports inline (up to 5 hops)"
    ] = True,
    cwd: Annotated[
        str | None, "Working directory override. Defaults to CWD or --root."
    ] = None,
) -> str:
    """Query, read, and curate durable OKF v0.2 + Claude Code memory concepts for this project."""
    from buddhi.mcp.tools.memory import execute_buddhi_memory

    root_dir = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else OVERRIDE_ROOT
    try:
        return execute_buddhi_memory(
            action=action,
            query=query,
            kind=kind,
            scope=scope,
            active_files=active_files,
            node_id=node_id,
            title=title,
            summary=summary,
            body=body,
            path_globs=path_globs,
            sources=sources,
            tags=tags,
            expand_imports=expand_imports,
            root_path=root_dir,
        )
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"Error executing memory operation: {e}"

def test_resolve_imports_recursive_and_cycle(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ws = tmp_path / "ws"
    ws.mkdir()
    user = tmp_path / "user"
    user.mkdir()

    # File A imports File B
    file_b = ws / "b.md"
    file_b.write_text("# Section B\nContent from B.", encoding="utf-8")

    file_a = ws / "a.md"
    file_a.write_text("# Section A\n@b.md\nEnd of A.", encoding="utf-8")

    expanded = resolve_imports(file_a.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), file_a, ws, user)
    assert "# Section B" in expanded
    assert "Content from B." in expanded
    assert "End of A." in expanded

    # Circular import test: B imports A
    file_b.write_text("# Section B\n@a.md", encoding="utf-8")
    expanded_cycle = resolve_imports(
        file_a.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), file_a, ws, user
    )
    assert "@import-cycle-detected" in expanded_cycle

    # Depth exceeded test (6 levels deep)
    current = ws / "step0.md"
    current.write_text("depth 0", encoding="utf-8")
    for i in range(1, 8):
        nxt = ws / f"step{i}.md"
        nxt.write_text(f"@step{i - 1}.md", encoding="utf-8")

    deepest = ws / "step7.md"
    deep_expanded = resolve_imports(
        deepest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), deepest, ws, user, max_depth=5
    )
    assert "@import-depth-exceeded" in deep_expanded

def test_execute_buddhi_memory_tool(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ws = tmp_path / "workspace"
    ws.mkdir()
    code_file = ws / "handler.py"
    code_file.write_text("def handle_request(): pass\n", encoding="utf-8")

    # 1. Action: remember
    res = execute_buddhi_memory(
        action="remember",
        title="Async Handlers",
        summary="All API handlers must be async.",
        body="Detailed body note.",
        kind="convention",
        scope="project",
        path_globs=["handler.py"],
        sources=["handler.py#L1-L1"],
        root_path=ws,
    )
    data = json.loads(res)
    assert data["status"] == "success"
    node_id = data["id"]
    assert "mem-convention-async-handlers" in node_id

    # 2. Action: status
    status_raw = execute_buddhi_memory(action="status", root_path=ws)
    status_data = json.loads(status_raw)
    assert status_data["total_nodes"] == 1
    assert status_data["budget"]["is_valid"]

    # 3. Action: search with path glob match
    search_match = execute_buddhi_memory(
        action="search",
        query="async",
        active_files=["handler.py"],
        root_path=ws,
    )
    s_data = json.loads(search_match)
    assert s_data["count"] == 1

    # Search with non-matching path
    search_nomatch = execute_buddhi_memory(
        action="search",
        query="async",
        active_files=["other.py"],
        root_path=ws,
    )
    s_nomatch = json.loads(search_nomatch)
    assert s_nomatch["count"] == 0

    # 4. Action: read
    read_out = execute_buddhi_memory(
        action="read",
        node_id=node_id,
        root_path=ws,
    )
    assert "All API handlers must be async." in read_out
